 Over the years, tmux gained a devoted following in the developer community.
 Its plugin ecosystem, enabled by tools like TPM (Tmux Plugin Manager),
 transformed it from a simple multiplexer into a highly customizable
 development environment. Today, tmux remains one of the most widely used
 terminal multiplexers, a testament to TJ Sturdivant's original vision of
 building something simpler and more elegant than what came before.
